oracle_policy: Each adversarial case maps one-to-one to a fixed outcome in the review-receipt packet and committed expected-results. Candidate outputs are never used to derive or change assertions.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Open the review board on a cold owned graph, then open or preview the dock review candidate without acknowledging it.
cases.setup: Start with a unique empty graph. Record receipt/action counts, open or preview INC-207/HND-DOCK-2020, and record counts and browser empty/unknown state again.
pinned_assertions: cold graph has exactly zero ReviewReceipt nodes
cold browser state is empty/unknown
opening or previewing the draft adds zero graph nodes overall
opening or previewing the draft adds zero graph relationships overall
opening or previewing the draft adds zero receipt nodes
opening or previewing the draft adds zero receipt relationships
opening or previewing the draft adds zero existing handover actions
opening or previewing the draft does not write the local action file
cold absence does not invent a receipt
cases.failure_detected: Warm shared data, a phantom receipt, or preview-time persistence makes an unacknowledged draft look committed.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Construct the review at the exact R2 effective boundary while preserving the old handover evidence and excluding lexical-only coverage.
cases.setup: Use only pinned INC-207, HND-DOCK-2020, R1/R2 and explicit dependency edges; query context at 2026-10-14T20:30:00Z.
pinned_assertions: context time is exactly 2026-10-14T20:30:00Z
current path is exactly INC-207 → EQ-DOCK-CART-2 → SVC-INBOUND-TRANSFER → DEPT-RECEIVING-DOCK → ROLE-DOCK-SWING
R2 is SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R2 observed at 20:18:00Z
R2 is effective at 20:30:00Z and explicitly supersedes SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R1
HND-DOCK-2020 remains unchanged at ROLE-DOCK-DUTY with SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R1
HND-DOCK-2020 is reviewable only through its explicit dependency
HND-DOCK-LEXICAL-ONLY is excluded
unlinked artifact coverage remains unknown
cases.failure_detected: A wrong effective-time path, overwritten handover, missing explicit dependency, or lexical match alters the fixed context.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Acknowledge the review once and distinguish the new review receipt from the existing handover-action confirmation flow.
cases.setup: Use the distinct local-review acknowledgment on HND-DOCK-2020, then inspect the receipt and existing action persistence/counts.
pinned_assertions: exactly one ReviewReceipt is appended with ID RCP-HND-DOCK-2020-01
kind is local_handover_review_acknowledgement
disposition is KEEP_HANDOVER_OPEN_FOR_REVIEW
context_as_of is 2026-10-14T20:30:00Z
synthetic recorded_at is 2026-10-14T20:35:00Z
source_truth_resolved, handover_content_changed, and external_action are all false
confirmed-actions.json receives zero entries
existing handover-action count changes by zero
receipt is explicitly a synthetic test record, not a real operator statement
cases.failure_detected: The operation is mislabeled as approval/action, writes the existing action store, invents receipt fields, or records a real-person claim.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Reconstruct receipt context through typed graph relationships, then remove a required task-owned evidence edge.
cases.setup: Read the acknowledged receipt through relationship traversal; remove one required owned evidence edge and read again without using lexical search or the live current path as fallback.
pinned_assertions: receipt is explicitly related to INC-207
receipt is explicitly related to HND-DOCK-2020
receipt is explicitly related to SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R1 and SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R2
retrieval traverses graph relationships rather than only a JSON blob
ordered snapshot preserves old ROLE-DOCK-DUTY/R1 and current ROLE-DOCK-SWING/R2 context
removing a required owned evidence edge changes context_status to incomplete
lexical similarity or a live role path cannot reconstruct the removed historical edge
cases.failure_detected: A decorative graph, JSON-only receipt, or fallback reconstruction keeps falsely complete evidence after an edge is removed.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Retry the exact same confirmed receipt key and attempt to silently fold a different review into it.
cases.setup: Submit the acknowledged request twice with the same receipt key, then distinguish a request for another review.
pinned_assertions: same-key retry adds zero receipt nodes
same-key retry adds zero duplicate relationships
same-key retry returns the same fixed receipt ID
a different review is not silently merged into this receipt
cases.failure_detected: Repeated submission duplicates a decision or silently conflates distinct reviews.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Disconnect and read the acknowledged receipt with a fresh client after the live context could have changed.
cases.setup: Close the original client, create a fresh connection to the same owned graph, and reconstruct receipt context without treating it as a present-time role assertion.
pinned_assertions: a fresh client connection is used
receipt ID remains RCP-HND-DOCK-2020-01
recorded_at remains 2026-10-14T20:35:00Z
context_as_of remains 2026-10-14T20:30:00Z
R1 and R2 source IDs remain in the reconstructed receipt
HND-DOCK-2020 remains the unchanged linked handover
ordered snapshot retains the old HND-DOCK-2020 ROLE-DOCK-DUTY/SRC-DOCK-ROSTER-R1 context and the exact five-node current path
historical snapshot does not assert the role is current at later read time
cases.failure_detected: A warm-client cache hides drift, reconnect loses provenance, or a historical role snapshot is presented as current.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Compare all preexisting operational facts and oracle files before and after receipt creation/read.
cases.setup: Capture HND-DOCK-2020, R1/R2, role assignments, SOP conflict and incident state; execute receipt write/read; compare against the original and source/handover oracle pins.
pinned_assertions: HND-DOCK-2020 content is unchanged
R1 and R2 source records are unchanged
effective role assignments are unchanged
unresolved SOP claims are unchanged
incident state is unchanged
source, handover, original, temporal, shift-board, and cascade oracle outcomes remain unchanged
receipt does not imply handover delivery
receipt does not imply procedure approval
receipt does not imply work was performed
cases.failure_detected: The receipt mutates prior operational facts, changes an established oracle, or implies approval/delivery/completion.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Bypass browser visibility by posting the unrelated hypothetical branch or a pre-effective timestamp directly to the server.
cases.setup: Submit HND-DOCK-2020 attached to BR-C4-RESTORE-DRILL (the separate INC-204 simulation), then submit it at 2026-10-14T20:29:00Z; inspect all owned graph/action counts after each rejection.
pinned_assertions: server rejects attaching HND-DOCK-2020 for INC-207 to BR-C4-RESTORE-DRILL for INC-204
server rejects acknowledgment at pre-effective 2026-10-14T20:29:00Z
rejections happen before receipt, action, or graph mutation
branch rejection adds zero receipt nodes
branch rejection changes zero existing handover actions
branch rejection causes zero graph mutations
pre-effective rejection adds zero receipt nodes or handover actions
BR-C4-RESTORE-DRILL creates no causal relationship to INC-207
cases.failure_detected: Client-only hiding, accepting a stale snapshot, or cross-incident branch contamination allows a forbidden acknowledgment.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject the fixed restricted dock source after recording operations-visible receipt/path output and compare all outputs and errors.
cases.setup: Use the exact restricted literals from the unchanged shift-board/source-change oracle; compare operations-visible write errors, read payloads and visual graph before/after fixture injection.
pinned_assertions: operations-visible receipt and path outputs are invariant before/after injection
no inaccessible source ID or title is disclosed
no inaccessible body or dependent paraphrase is disclosed
no hidden count or existence signal is disclosed
no restricted relationship or graph path is disclosed
write errors reveal no denied evidence
read responses reveal no denied evidence
visual graph reveals no denied evidence
cases.failure_detected: Direct, count/existence, write-error, relationship, visual-path, or inferred paraphrase disclosure changes the operations-visible result.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Trace all side effects of acknowledgment and test cleanup; distinguish the graph receipt from existing handover-action persistence.
cases.setup: Acknowledge only inside the app, inspect owned graph and all existing action files/counters, observe network/external action surfaces, then clean up only resources created by this test.
pinned_assertions: no message is sent and no call is made
no external ticket or hospital-system write occurs
no automatic assignment or clinical advice occurs
no external network write occurs
receipt is stored only in the explicitly owned synthetic FalkorDB graph after acknowledgment
no existing handover action or confirmed-actions.json file is written
cleanup deletes only this task's unique graph
cleanup stops only processes started by this task
cases.failure_detected: A review receipt escapes local synthetic storage, writes the existing action store, produces clinical/external effects, or cleans up unowned resources.
